name: contract-return-names
goal: Returns show descriptive value names beside types/examples; no Throws table when no errors are declared

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Return groups hide names and use a hardcoded return value label; Throws forces keepEmpty. Expected: named return values beside type/example and no table for undeclared errors. Reuse ContractTable; qualify return field names by callable.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing contract and shared browser API scenarios asserted empty Throws tables and never asserted return names. Extend these standard scenarios for declared return row names, modal titles, optional error tables and named-field selection at current/historical scopes.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only commit 8298d5cb; immutable red record 4e9e63af90dfdfdd1de688bad79e9cb69a936b61109f625631d14f39466b2207. Standard SSR and desktop/tablet/mobile current/historical API scenarios fail because the return table lacks the declared value name.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
